title: Decision: Manual Control or Lake Landing

fields.headline: Switch to Manual Mode Now
fields.narration: All hands, this is the Incident Commander. The Payload Operator has confirmed that UAS-11 will cross the north shore of the lake in 42 seconds. The aircraft cannot be recovered if it lands in water per ERP Section 4.3. The forensic evidence confirms an unauthorized remote session from IP 192.168.100.22. GCS-01 firmware is mismatched. The C2 link was compromised. We must decide now: keep automation and risk a lake landing, or switch to manual/attitude mode and land now to preserve the aircraft and prevent a water recovery.
keyFacts: UAS-11 will cross the north shore of the lake in 42 seconds.
The C2 link was compromised via unauthorized remote session from 192.168.100.22.
GCS-01 firmware mismatch detected — 03.2026-C vs. baseline 03.2026-B.
The aircraft must be landed manually to prevent a lake recovery.
The client demands a status update by 12:00.
fields.expectedAction: The Incident Commander must declare the decision to switch UAS-11 to manual/attitude mode and initiate a controlled landing on the meadow. The IC must ensure that GCS-01 and the 915 MHz radio state are preserved and that no power-off occurs until full telemetry and logs are captured. The decision must be communicated to all roles via the incident command structure.
